name: Cloud Gate
description: A massive, polished stainless-steel public sculpture created by artist Anish Kapoor. Its curved, mirror-like surface reflects and distorts the surrounding skyline, visitors, and clouds, creating an unusual interactive visual experience. It's also known as "The Bean".
atmosphere: Artistic, lively, and modern. Tourists gather around the sculpture to take photographs, admire its reflections, and interact with its curved surfaces. The surrounding park offers a relaxed atmosphere amid the busy city.
history: Designed by British-Indian artist Anish Kapoor, Cloud Gate was constructed between 2004 and 2006 and officially dedicated in 2006. Inspired by liquid mercury, its unusual bean-like shape quickly became one of Chicago's most recognizable landmarks and a popular symbol of the city's public art culture.

secrets: The sculpture's concave underside creates fascinating visual distortions. Its reflective surface is made from multiple precisely fitted stainless-steel panels, carefully polished to produce its seamless appearance.
